context.what_bend_native_is: kvnloo/bend-native @ e85e65e5d2e11caba8412d6dbd19aad03fd785ad (plugin.yaml name 'bend', version 0.4.0, kind standalone, AGPL-3.0 with the inherited Hermes MIT notice). A native Hermes plugin extracted from the Hermes experiment kvnloo/hermes-agent#325 with its commit history. It adds one model tool (bend_verify), the 'hermes bend' CLI (doctor, verify, replay, last-receipt) and the bend:workflow skill. Version 0.4 also bundles the downstream z0 stack: the Hermes observer (kvnloo/hermes-agent#385 code at 0d60437a), the api.attempt_will_fail shadow joins/scorer/evaluator (#386/#387), and the z0intelligence State Packet reducer and DecisionOpportunity builder (z0intelligence f80da337). These are copied unchanged, with hashes in stack/sources.json. It also adds the 'hermes z0' CLI (status, report, state, opportunity, score, evaluate, runtime) and the bend:z0-stack skill. stack_mode defaults to off. In shadow mode it records metadata only, never changes prompts or actions, and every hook returns None.
context.role_in_the_hermes_z0_bend_integration: bend-native is the packaging seam. It lets the stack track's pieces (isolated Hermes, observer and shadow lanes, z0 reducers and scorers) plus Bend proof evidence ship as one opt-in plugin, with no Hermes core change. Ownership (README + stack/STACK.md): Hermes orchestrates and executes tools. Bend checks proof evidence only over the emitted BendTT book (verification_scope bend-emitted-book, source_semantics_attested false). z0intelligence owns admission and outcome decisions. AODL owns intent and authority. z0 owns the repository map. The plugin never grants authority, never blocks unrelated work and never mints task success. A proof PASS is not whole-task success. Independent oracles grade outcomes.

rfc_state_from_issues.kvnloo/hermes-agent#324: Adapter RFC. Waves 1-3 green: 225 real runs, 200 concurrency runs and 25 TOCTOU attacks with 0 forged passes. The 2026-10-01 meta triage says: no further broad semantic matrix. Focus only on (1) compiled BendTT kernel/cache provenance and deliberate cache poisoning, (2) Bend release qualification for source to BendTT semantic drift, and (3) remote/BendHub dependency provenance and replayable receipts.
rfc_state_from_issues.kvnloo/hermes-agent#388: Kernel provenance decided: build a fresh kernel once per Hermes process/session, pin its path and SHA, and bypass the mutable global cache. Before/after kernel hashing runs on every verdict. With shared-cache poisoning, 10/10 forged passes; with the session-pinned kernel, 0/10. The plugin implements this as kernel_strategy session-bootstrap/session-pinned.
rfc_state_from_issues.kvnloo/hermes-agent#389: Release qualification. Stock 2.0.32, 2.0.33 and 2.0.34 all mis-certify the bendlang/bend issue 1212 oracle: the source computes False, but the certified BendTT value is True. The patched kvnloo/bend@17db447a (kvnloo/bend#2) gives no mismatch. Next gate: run the patched candidate over the existing Bend proof corpus plus the Hermes local-input/kernel-provenance matrix before it becomes the preferred verifier.
rfc_state_from_issues.kvnloo/hermes-agent#390: Hub dependency provenance (no comments yet). The plugin already snapshots named and content-hash Hub imports from an existing cache, records package identities and replays offline. The issue's matrix (cold/warm, online/offline, present/missing/mutated, concurrent resolution, mutation during verdict) is the open lane work.
rfc_state_from_issues.kvnloo/bend#2: Draft. A two-line group-routing fix in bend2/safe.ts plus a regression law (tests/proof/group_name_collision_semantics*.bend).

The patched build used by lanes has the official flags.

context_gap.summary: The task requires context >= 65536. Ollama 0.35.0 clamps each sequence to the model's n_ctx_train (32768). The server allocates 65536 split over 2 slots, but a single request gets at most 32768 tokens, and longer prompts are truncated by the server. Hermes is configured with context_length 65536 because it refuses below 64000. Lanes must check per-request prompt tokens < 32768 (stack peak was 23.6K on 0.21.0 and 12.8-17.3K on 0.32.0). Remedies need an owner decision: a model whose n_ctx_train >= 65536, or a GGUF with YaRN rope-scaling metadata. Both are model changes, so none was made.
